scope: Independent standard for w25q64jv on the fixed spi task configuration, based on its copied reference driver, fixed task requirements, supplied Zephyr API pack and harness. Excludes sample_ref application cadence and device-register behavior.

api_contract.fixed_task_context: spi1 DT device handle, spi_config and required CS context

handle_and_operations.handle: const struct device * plus struct spi_config (or spi_dt_spec for dt helper)

signatures.spi_transceive_dt: int spi_transceive_dt(const struct spi_dt_spec *spec, const struct spi_buf_set *tx_bufs, const struct spi_buf_set *rx_bufs)

handle_and_operations.configuration: master mode; 8-bit/MSB; ADXL345 mode 3, others mode 0 as appropriate; reference frequency and CS

headers: zephyr/kernel.h for timing calls where used
api_contract.return_semantics: Use the integer status from fallible bus/configuration calls; GPIO read yields level or error. UART poll_in is nonblocking: 0 means byte received, nonzero means no byte; poll_out returns void.

facts.requirement: Bind the required spi handle/configuration on fixed task context: spi1 DT device handle, spi_config and required CS context.

Provide the task-required operations with compatible signatures: int spi_transceive_dt(const struct spi_dt_spec *spec, const struct spi_buf_set *tx_bufs, const struct spi_buf_set *rx_bufs). Keep handle/address/configuration, buffer and return levels compatible with the reference.
Use master, 8-bit, MSB-first SPI; preserve the reference mode (ADXL345 mode 3; MAX31855/MCP3008 mode 0; W25Q64JV configured at 8 MHz) and chip-select control where required.
Preserve the fallible API status needed to detect or propagate bus/GPIO configuration and transaction failures; do not convert an error return into success.
